title: FinalTags competition settings
description: Describes the `data` of the WCIF extension `finaltags.competition`, which FinalTags (https://aasalobrena.github.io/finaltags/) attaches to a competition. It stores print settings and optional custom tag data. Every property is optional; FinalTags falls back to the defaults noted below.

logoUrl.description: Absolute URL of the competition logo, printed on every tag. An empty string means no logo.

paperSize.description: Paper size used when printing tags, two tags per sheet. `a4` is 210 x 297 mm and `letter` is 8.5 x 11 in.

customTags.description: Custom tag designs and competitor data for unofficial events or side events. Each item configures one event.

name.description: User-defined name used to identify this set of event tags.

competitionLogoUrl.description: Optional competition logo URL shown on custom tags.

eventId.description: WCA event id, or `custom` when using a custom event logo.

eventLogoUrl.description: Custom event logo URL, used when eventId is `custom`.

competitors.description: Competitors and individually customized seed tag values.

personId.description: WCIF registrant id, or `custom` for a manually entered name.

flag.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 flag country, empty for no flag, or `custom`.

flagUrl.description: Optional custom flag image URL, overriding the flag for the country code.

result.description: Free-form seed result printed exactly as entered.

region.description: Defines who counts as a local competitor and whether locals are placed first.

type.description: Kind of region that defines locals. With `world` every competitor is local.

id.description: For `country`, the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code used by the WCA, e.g. `ES`. For `continent`, the WCA continent id: `_Africa`, `_Asia`, `_Europe`, `_North America`, `_Oceania` or `_South America`. Not used when `type` is `world`.

prioritizeLocals.description: When true, local competitors are listed first and their seeds are numbered among locals only. When false, the region is stored but has no effect on the tags.
